These compounds, in turn, are linked to the activation of ATR, a serine/threonine-protein kinase involved in cellular stress responses and DNA repair. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this pathway, with Path 1 having a slightly higher score. The shared involvement of the Werner syndrome ATP-dependent helicase as a common target suggests a possible convergent mechanism, where Levodopa may influence ATR through different downstream pathways.
